work.title: Nonzero provider-departure evidence with reviewer-governed normalization boundary
authority: Direct user authorization: create RS-PROVIDER-DEPARTURE-004 corpus.
Direct user decision: calculate evidence only; normalization remains reviewer-governed.

intent.productGoal: Support a forward-looking QoR review with lineaged nonzero provider-departure evidence without automatically converting evidence into a professional adjustment.
intent.capability: Calculate and expose per-provider pre-departure and post-departure observed billed populations with FTE, departure date, and lineage; ingest an authored synthetic corpus through the standard ZIP path; and compare deterministic output with its post-run truth contract.
architecturalIntent: Observed historical revenue, derived departure evidence, and reviewer-governed normalization remain separate objects.
The calculation is run-bound, uses immutable scope, and does not rewrite canonical claims or cash.
An authored truth contract is excluded from intake and inspected only after immutable execution.
invariants: Post-departure observed revenue is reported as evidence, never automatically removed or normalized.
Providers without a dated departure before valuation do not receive an inferred departure impact.
Independent reconciliations and release gates remain authoritative and unforced.
acceptanceEvidence: Dedicated core regression test for pre/post departure separation and absence of automatic adjustment.
Workbench Analyze extension and workbook Provider Analysis disclosure of post-departure evidence.
Run 6884cf5f-724b-4d18-8d6d-a0f27f0d6ede and all 15 post-run truth-contract assertions.

decisions.decision: Use evidence-only post-departure measurement rather than an automatic normalization formula.
decisions.rationale: Professional adjustment methodology and replacement-capacity treatment require explicit reviewer authority; deterministic evidence can be calculated without claiming that judgment.

decisions.decision: Treat the authored corpus truth contract as regression evidence, not blind acceptance evidence.
decisions.rationale: The corpus and its comparison contract were authored together under direct user authority.

observedBehaviour: PRV-DEP with FTE 1.0 and 2026-04-15 departure produced $1,000.00 pre-departure observed billed and $3,500.00 post-departure observed billed across two valuation-bounded claims.
The run retained zero automatic normalization and unchanged canonical claim, cash, A/R, reconciliation, finding, and gate authority boundaries.
All 15 truth-contract assertions matched; all four financial controls matched; G7 remained blocked.

evidence.result: 22/22 core tests passed, including departure-date boundary, post-departure amount/count, valuation exclusion, and no automatic normalization behavior.

evidence.reference: pnpm --filter @redwood/core typecheck; pnpm --filter @redwood/workbench typecheck; pnpm build
evidence.result: Core and workbench checks and rebuilt assets passed.
Accepted evidence-only calculation and reviewer-governed normalization boundary.
All 15 declared corpus assertions matched; reconciliations matched; G4 passed and G7 remained blocked.
Provider Analysis records pre/post-departure observed billed, FTE, date, claim count, and evidence-only treatment.

divergences.expected: Acceptance evidence is independent and hidden before execution.
divergences.observed: The truth contract was authored with the synthetic corpus under direct authority and inspected after execution.

learning.recurringPattern: Nonzero post-departure observed revenue is not equivalent to a go-forward QoR adjustment.
durableKnowledge: The departure-date claim is included in the pre-departure population; the next dated claim begins the post-departure population.
Evidence-only provider departure measurement leaves claims, cash, A/R, recovery, realizable revenue, findings, gates, and release authority unchanged.
An authored truth contract proves deterministic regression behaviour but is not a blind acceptance test.
